title: Multi-layout viewport closure and peer-reader failure isolation
mode: Deeper/broader primary-source research and plan refinement
existingFindingRefined: PAR-144 under the existing 7G.3 layout graph / DWG writer owner ledger

sources.project: Open Design Alliance DWG specification v5.4.1
sources.observation: R13-R2000 BLOCK_HEADER contains first/last entity soft pointers; R2004+ contains an owned-object count and repeated hard-owner entity references. Common LAYOUT data includes name, tab order, flags, associated paper-space BLOCK_RECORD soft pointer, and last-active-viewport soft pointer; R2004+ adds a viewport count and repeated viewport soft pointers.
sources.disposition: Add per-version structural verification of entity ownership and LAYOUT viewport references; ODA remains authoritative for DWG byte layout.

sources.observation: One Model layout and multiple Paper layouts are supported; the special *PAPER_SPACE record points to the last active Paper layout. CTAB is a drawing-saved system variable, while LayoutManager exposes current layout, tab order, selected state, and associated BlockTableRecord. Autodesk's documented DXF HEADER variable table does not list $CTAB, so do not assume it is serialized as a literal DXF header pair.
sources.disposition: Check canonical *PAPER_SPACE-to-LAYOUT association in serialized DWG/DXF structure and query CTAB/CurrentLayout separately in a native host; keep selected state and tab order distinct.

sources.observation: The technical documentation describes a main paper-space viewport with ID 1, points it to the associated layout block record, and distinguishes active paper entities stored in ENTITIES from inactive layout BLOCKS content. It phrases the required-ID statement tentatively.
sources.disposition: Use ID 1 plus a distinct additional viewport as a compatibility test profile, not as DWG wire-format authority.

sources.observation: A generated AC1015 report says the writer emitted non-active layout first/last entity handles but the ACadRust 0.6.3/main reader dropped those links and assigned all paper entities to the active layout; the same report's AC1032 case passed. A fix commit is referenced, but this research did not verify a released/pinned artifact containing it.
sources.disposition: Do not use an affected AC1015 peer readback as a writer verdict. Inspect emitted legacy chains and verify the exact peer artifact before qualification.

sources.observation: A historical viewport-not-present/property-overrides report closed with layout/viewport changes. Open issue 1184 reports invalid-range ShadePlotDPI assignment dropping LAYOUT objects and dictionary entries in DWG, or losing values/reporting errors in DXF.
sources.disposition: Include viewport handle identity/ownership in the generated DWG case; test DXF group-69 viewport IDs only in the DXF profile. Pin the peer and examine its diagnostics and plot settings before interpreting absent layouts.

sources.observation: A report against 0.14.8556 describes dwg2dxf returning success after truncated DXF output lacking ENTITIES and EOF; the decoded input also showed an implausible layout count amid object-map errors.
sources.disposition: Require complete section termination, expected layout/entity census, exact executable revision, and diagnostics; exit code alone is insufficient.

limitations: Research reconciles primary format/application documentation and project issue/source reports. No peer executable, native CAD application, or local regression suite was run. Peer reports are not local reproductions or format authority; the local working tree remains broadly dirty and this pass made no source/test changes.
